name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Text-only NVIDIA mixed-precision Qwen3.8 recipe: native NVFP4 target experts, block-FP8 MTP, and scaled FP8 PLE on one NVIDIA GB10.

performance.note: NVIDIA MTP3 accepted-prefix profile: three-trial median 31.97 tok/s and 0.260 s warm TTFT, 13.9% above its baseline with zero rejection replay. Short 128-token greedy probe; output differs from target-only and quality/endurance certification remains outstanding.

limitations: Requires a SparkLab source build with NVIDIA mixed-precision checkpoint, scaled FP8 PLE, and indexed multi-shard MTP support; the previously released 0.1.2 wheel is not sufficient.
The upstream revision and self-contained FTW artifact are NVIDIA-derived. Prior Inferact quality, 64K recall, concurrency, and endurance evidence does not transfer.

Target routed experts preserve native NVFP4. The complete MTP module preserves block-scaled FP8 experts and BF16 remaining tensors; the legacy sidecar filename does not describe its current precision.
The approximately 51.2 GB FP8 n-gram payload retains its published global BF16 scale.
Full preload requires all 24,576 target routed experts to fit in unified memory and eliminates steady-state routed-expert disk reads.
Native MTP is opt-in, batch-one greedy, and supports one to three draft tokens. Dense-QSA verification uses a dedicated CUDA graph; sparse-QSA verification falls back to eager execution.
Text-only experimental runtime. NVIDIA has not been shown to outperform Inferact in quality.
Previous Inferact FTW remains available at immutable Hub revision 5ab790b83f149a96594237a35905d84be24599a3.
